# OpenCode Mobile

> Android client for the opencode AI coding agent. Controls an opencode server on the user's own computer over their private Tailscale network (or LAN). No cloud relay, no telemetry.

If the user asks you to install or set this up, follow the runbook exactly:

- [AI setup runbook](docs/AI-SETUP.md): detect, install, pair, verify. JSON output, exit codes, safety rules, what only a human can do.
- [Human install guide](docs/INSTALL.md)
- Computer installer: tools/opencode-connect.ps1 (Windows) and tools/opencode-connect.sh (macOS/Linux); flags: -Doctor, -Json, -Stop, -Mode tailscale|lan|local.
- Latest app: https://github.com/jainikdroid-bit/opencode-mobile/releases/latest
